title: BearerAuth accepts tokens containing spaces
description: BearerAuth::new checks token.trim().is_empty() but does not reject tokens with embedded spaces. RFC 6750 §2.1 defines the bearer token as a b64token (base64url chars only; no spaces). A token like 'abc def' passes trim(), HeaderValue::from_str allows spaces (0x20 is valid in field-value), and gets sent as 'Authorization: Bearer abc def'. Servers that strictly parse RFC 6750 will reject this. The whitespace-only rejection exists but a token with an embedded space (not whitespace-only) slips through. Should also reject tokens containing whitespace anywhere.
